source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Low creeping shrub with aerial roots, erect shrub, or low- to high-climbing vine
morphology_documented.leaves: Usually 3(–5) leaflets; narrowed apex; some leaflets often deeply lobed or sharply toothed, glabrous or pubescent below
morphology_documented.fruit: Glabrous or with occasional hairs (genus key)
morphology_documented.habitat: Low woods, forest margins, disturbed areas and varied habitats

source_scope_note: Only traits documented in cited flora; null/omitted traits not inferred. Genus-key traits indicated where relevant.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Flora warns subspecies overlap morphologically and can be hard to distinguish; it keys subsp. verrucosum, negundo, pubens
Historical species may overlap the separate indexed subsp. rydbergii; no unsupported equivalence inferred
Causes contact dermatitis; handle field photos/specimens accordingly
preservation: Additive research record; original species.json, photos, credits, and galleries unchanged
